pr_title: Fix log expectation inconsistency in flush test

review_comment: nit: the comment should be moved together with the `shard.flushOnIdle(0)` call?

Well, the problem was that the addExpectation was done after the flushOnIdle() call which made the test fail. It needs to be before. So I made a comment about the whole "paragraph" of code, which combines the explanation of doing a flushOnIdle but also adding the expectation for the log message. So moving the comment afterwards would not explain the log expectation, that is why I prefer it is there above the "paragraph".
